name: Occidental-Tor
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a binary sunset, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Nothing about the signal of unknown origin appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
